## Decision flowchart

```{mermaid}
flowchart TD
  A[Start: what's your goal?] --> B{Variance components<br/>or breeding values?}
  B -->|Just BVs, fast| C[masreml: GBLUP]
  B -->|Need posterior<br/>uncertainty| D[masbayes: BayesA]
  B -->|Sparse architecture<br/>variable selection| E[masbayes: BayesR]
  A --> F{GWAS / SNP effects?}
  F -->|Single-marker| G[masreml: run_gwas]
  F -->|Multi-marker| E
```
